summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing a strategic reinsurance and asset management partnership with Wilton Re. Wilton Re will form Windsor Life Re, a U.S. and Bermuda-domiciled reinsurer, with approximately US$900 million of capital, each contributing about one-third of equity. Windsor Life Re will reinsure an initial US$1.7 billion in-force block, with expected growth to US$10 billion assets. SLC Management, a Sun Life subsidiary, serves as lead asset manager. Jefferies and Sidley Austin advised Sun Life; Ardea Partners, Wells Fargo, and Debevoise advised Wilton Re. Launch expected in H1 2027, subject to regulatory approvals. This is a joint venture, not a conventional M&A special situation.
